notes: This is the state-law layer: the federal-state s.218 Social Security coverage agreement for public employees, and the Kentucky Employees Retirement System (part of the Kentucky Public Pensions Authority). Federal OASDI itself is 42 U.S.C. ch.7 and private-sector occupational pensions are pre-empted by ERISA (29 U.S.C. 1001); teachers and county employees have their own systems (KRS Chapters 161 and 78).
